add.title: Part types demo: one label above each of the six blocks; decide whether part-file keeps its file's own heading; Meter.js style to a class
add.why: Review of part-types (part-types/review/report.md findings 1, 2, 4): part-heading and part-text carry no label, part-link shows the linked page's title, part-file drops notes.md's h1 so the block starts mid-thought, and Meter.js sets style inline in the first example agents will copy.
